comments.comment: Late term abortions do exist. Your website says you provide abortions up to 34 weeks. You say they don’t exist on your slide but then only talk about it being a political term. How don’t they exist? If you offer them at your clinic? Saying “we provide abortions up to 34 weeks” is just another way of saying “late term”. It’s all still the same thing, killing a baby.
